- **Injectable PrEP (Apretude):** This is an injection given every two months. It also lowers the chance of getting HIV by about 99% when given on schedule.

- **Injectable PrEP (Yeztugo):** This is a newer injection given every six months. It has similar effectiveness to the other methods.

Both oral and injectable PrEP are up to 99% effective to prevent HIV infection when taken as directed. 

It's important to talk to your healthcare provider about which option works best for you!
